subtasks.description: Check all scripts in /scripts/components/ for completeness, including inputs, outputs, and error handling. Cross-check with the inventory/classification report.

subtasks.title: Review all scripts in /scripts/utils/ for completeness and reusability
subtasks.description: Ensure all scripts in /scripts/utils/ are complete and reusable. Document any gaps or issues found.

subtasks.description: Audit documentation in /docs/pages/components/ for accuracy and coverage of all components and workflows.

subtasks.title: Review all configuration files for completeness and alignment
subtasks.description: Check all relevant configuration files for completeness and alignment with operational discipline. Document any issues found.

subtasks.title: Cross-check reviewed items with the inventory/classification report
subtasks.description: Ensure all reviewed scripts, docs, and configs are cross-checked against the inventory/classification findings for completeness.

subtasks.title: Test and document containerized deployment workflow for PeaceFestivalUSA
subtasks.description: Run and validate the new dev container workflow for PeaceFestivalUSA using custom arguments/configs. Update documentation and task process to reflect containerized, argument-driven deployment and testing.
subtasks.details:
- Update Dockerfile.dev to replace mysql-client with mariadb-client
- Rebuild dev container
- Run install_peacefestivalusa_wordpress.sh inside the dev container with custom arguments
- Validate deployment and test scripts
- Document the workflow and update process docs
- Ensure this workflow is reflected in the AgencyStack operational discipline and task management system

tasks.title: Consolidate and deduplicate overlapping logic or documentation
tasks.description: Identify and merge duplicate or overlapping logic and documentation across scripts and docs. Ensure a single source of truth for each component and process.

subtasks.title: Identify overlapping scripts or logic in /scripts/components/ and /scripts/utils/
subtasks.description: Scan /scripts/components/ and /scripts/utils/ for overlapping or duplicate scripts and logic. Document all overlaps for consolidation.

subtasks.title: Identify duplicated or outdated documentation in /docs/pages/components/
subtasks.description: Audit /docs/pages/components/ for duplicated or outdated documentation. Flag all issues for consolidation or removal.

subtasks.title: Propose consolidation plans for each set of overlaps/duplicates
subtasks.description: For each identified overlap or duplicate, propose a clear consolidation plan and document the rationale.

subtasks.title: Merge or remove redundant files, ensuring all changes are tracked in the repo
subtasks.description: Execute consolidation by merging or removing redundant files/scripts/docs. Ensure all changes are repository-tracked and auditable.

subtasks.title: Update references in docs and scripts to point to consolidated sources
subtasks.description: Update all documentation and scripts to reference only the consolidated, authoritative sources. Remove references to deprecated or removed files.

tasks.title: Update documentation to reflect current operational discipline and workflows
tasks.description: Update all relevant documentation to accurately reflect AgencyStack’s Charter, TDD protocol, and operational discipline. Ensure all changes are referenced and auditable.

subtasks.title: Update component docs to reference the latest workflows and Charter
subtasks.description: Update documentation in /docs/pages/components/ to reference the latest AgencyStack workflows, Charter, and operational discipline.

subtasks.title: Add missing documentation for any new or changed scripts/utilities
subtasks.description: Ensure all new or updated scripts and utilities are fully documented. Add missing docs as needed.

subtasks.title: Ensure all documentation includes TDD protocol and idempotency requirements
subtasks.description: Review and update all documentation to explicitly reference TDD protocol and idempotency requirements for each component or workflow.

subtasks.title: Review and update the Charter if new patterns or requirements are discovered
subtasks.description: If new operational patterns or requirements are discovered, update the Charter and reference them in relevant docs.

tasks.title: Validate all install scripts and Makefile targets for idempotency and auditability
tasks.description: Test all install scripts and Makefile targets to ensure they are idempotent, rerunnable, and produce auditable logs. Address any issues found.

subtasks.title: Test each install script for idempotency
subtasks.description: Run each install script multiple times to ensure it can be rerun without harmful side effects. Document any issues found.

subtasks.title: Test each Makefile target for idempotency and correct dependency tracking
subtasks.description: Run each Makefile target repeatedly and in different orders to ensure proper idempotency and dependency management. Document all findings.

subtasks.title: Ensure all scripts and targets produce auditable logs in /var/log/agency_stack/components/
subtasks.description: Verify that all install scripts and Makefile targets output logs to /var/log/agency_stack/components/. Update scripts as needed for auditability.

subtasks.title: Document any failures and fix issues in scripts/targets as needed
subtasks.description: For any failures or issues found during idempotency or auditability testing, document and resolve them in the repository.

tasks.title: Ensure all changes are repository-tracked and follow the proper change workflow
tasks.description: Verify that all modifications are made in the repository, tracked via version control, and deployed only using approved workflows. No direct modifications to live VMs or containers.

subtasks.title: Verify all modifications are committed to the repo before deployment
subtasks.description: Ensure every change is committed to the repository before any deployment or operational use. Review commit logs for completeness.

subtasks.title: Ensure no direct modifications are made to live VMs or containers
subtasks.description: Audit all operational changes to confirm they are made via repository-tracked scripts, Makefile targets, or automated SSH—not direct intervention.

subtasks.title: Confirm all deployments use tracked scripts, Makefile targets, or automated SSH commands
subtasks.description: Review and enforce that all deployments are performed using repository-tracked, auditable methods only.

subtasks.title: Review commit messages and PRs for auditability and documentation
subtasks.description: Check that all commit messages and pull requests are clear, descriptive, and document the rationale for changes.

tasks.title: Prepare a summary report of findings and next steps
tasks.description: Document the review and consolidation process, summarize findings, and outline actionable next steps for continuous improvement.

subtasks.title: Summarize key findings from the review, consolidation, and validation steps
subtasks.description: Aggregate and summarize all major findings from the review, consolidation, and validation tasks into a clear, actionable summary.

subtasks.title: List actionable next steps and recommendations for continuous improvement
subtasks.description: Based on findings, prepare a prioritized list of next steps and recommendations for ongoing improvement of AgencyStack.

subtasks.title: Share the report with stakeholders and incorporate feedback
subtasks.description: Distribute the summary report to all relevant stakeholders, collect feedback, and incorporate it into the documentation and future plans.

subtasks.title: Archive the report in the repository for future reference
subtasks.description: Ensure the final summary report is stored in the repository in a discoverable location for future audits and reference.

tasks.title: Validate and classify all scripts and key files as usable, redundant, or irrelevant
tasks.description: Inventory all scripts and key files. Determine which are actively executed or referenced, which are stand-alone duplicates or redundant, and which are irrelevant/disposable. Document findings to prioritize further review and consolidation.
tasks.details: A comprehensive checklist for manual verification and merging before removing redundant PeaceFestivalUSA scripts has been generated and is available at `/scripts/classification_merge_checklist.md`. This checklist will guide the consolidation process for identified redundant scripts.
tasks.testStrategy: Use the generated merge checklist to verify that all functionality from redundant scripts is properly integrated into main scripts before removal. Test each merged feature individually and then perform integration testing of the consolidated scripts.

subtasks.title: Inventory All Scripts and Key Files
subtasks.description: Compile a comprehensive list of all scripts and key files within the target environment, including their locations and basic metadata.
subtasks.details: Scan directories and repositories for scripts and key files. Record file names, paths, sizes, modification dates, and any available descriptions. Use automation tools where possible to ensure completeness and accuracy.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify the inventory against known directories and repositories. Cross-check with team members to ensure no files are missed.

subtasks.title: Identify Execution and Reference Status
subtasks.description: Determine which scripts and key files are actively executed or referenced by other systems, applications, or processes.
subtasks.details: Analyze logs, configuration files, and codebases to trace execution and references. Use static analysis tools and search for file invocations in scripts, schedulers, and deployment pipelines.
subtasks.testStrategy: Spot-check a sample of identified files by simulating or reviewing execution paths to confirm active use.

subtasks.title: Detect Redundant or Duplicate Files
subtasks.description: Identify scripts and key files that are stand-alone duplicates or serve redundant purposes within the environment.
subtasks.details: Compare file contents using checksums or diff tools to find duplicates. Review file purposes and overlap in functionality to flag redundancies. Document findings with references to original and duplicate locations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Manually review flagged duplicates and redundancies to confirm accuracy. Validate with stakeholders if necessary.

subtasks.title: Classify Files as Usable, Redundant, or Irrelevant
subtasks.description: Categorize each script and key file based on its execution status and redundancy analysis into usable, redundant, or irrelevant/disposable.
subtasks.details: Apply clear criteria: 'Usable' for actively referenced/executed files, 'Redundant' for duplicates or overlapping functionality, and 'Irrelevant' for files not referenced or obsolete. Document the rationale for each classification.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review a sample of classifications with team members to ensure consistency and correctness.

subtasks.title: Document Findings and Prioritize for Review
subtasks.description: Create a detailed report summarizing the inventory, classifications, and recommendations for further review and consolidation.
subtasks.details: Prepare a structured document or spreadsheet listing all files, their classifications, and notes on priority for review or consolidation. Highlight critical files and those requiring immediate attention.
subtasks.testStrategy: Share the report with stakeholders for feedback and validation. Adjust documentation based on input received.

subtasks.title: Implement PeaceFestivalUSA Script Merge Checklist
subtasks.description: Use the generated merge checklist to consolidate redundant PeaceFestivalUSA scripts into main scripts while preserving all functionality.
subtasks.details: Follow the checklist at `/scripts/classification_merge_checklist.md` to merge specific features including: Docker-in-Docker support, test logic, environment config saving, SSH/remote logic, file/DB sync, dry-run options, HTTP-only mode, Traefik/test artifact logic, and TDD logic into appropriate main scripts.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each merged feature individually to ensure functionality is preserved. Perform integration testing of consolidated scripts to verify all features work together properly.

subtasks.title: Verify Merged Functionality Before Removal
subtasks.description: Thoroughly test all merged functionality to ensure no features or capabilities are lost during consolidation.
subtasks.details: Verify each item on the merge checklist including: Docker-in-Docker support, test environment configuration, SSH/remote capabilities, file/DB synchronization, dry-run functionality, HTTP-only mode, Traefik integration, test artifact handling, and TDD logic.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create test cases for each merged feature. Compare behavior of original scripts with consolidated scripts to ensure identical functionality.

subtasks.title: Document Changes and Remove Redundant Scripts
subtasks.description: Document all changes made during the consolidation process and safely remove redundant scripts after verification.
subtasks.details: Create comprehensive documentation of all merged features and their new locations. Update any references to old scripts in documentation, configuration files, and other scripts. After thorough verification, remove redundant scripts.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that all documentation is accurate and complete. Test that removal of redundant scripts does not break any functionality.

tasks.title: Systematic audit and fix of install_peacefestivalusa_wordpress.sh block structure
tasks.description: Audit all if/fi, while/done, and heredoc pairs. Remove duplicate flag logic. Refactor for maintainability. Ensure script passes bash -n syntax check.

tasks.title: Patch all privileged log file creation in /scripts/utils/ and /scripts/components/
tasks.description: Ensure all log file creation (touch, echo, tee) in /scripts/utils/ and /scripts/components/ use sudo tee for /var/log/agency_stack paths. Prevent permission errors for privileged log paths. Idempotent and compatible with both privileged and unprivileged environments.
tasks.details: Replace all direct touch/echo to privileged log files with conditional use of sudo tee. Ensure no ad-hoc fixes; all logic must be in repo scripts/utilities.

subtasks.title: Audit log file creation in /scripts/utils/
subtasks.description: Search for all instances of touch, echo, and tee in utility scripts. Identify patterns used for log file paths and permissions.

subtasks.title: Audit log file creation in /scripts/components/
subtasks.description: Focus on component installation scripts. Identify specific permission models used across components.

subtasks.title: Standardize privileged path detection
subtasks.description: Create consistent pattern for detecting /var/log/agency_stack paths. Implement robust path validation logic compliant with AgencyStack Charter v1.0.3.

subtasks.title: Implement sudo tee pattern for all identified instances
subtasks.description: Apply conditional sudo based on path for all log file operations. Ensure idempotency with proper error handling.

subtasks.title: Verify fixes across different environments
subtasks.description: Test in container, VM, and development environments. Validate specifically with Peace Festival USA deployment to ensure all privileged log operations work correctly.

tasks.title: Audit all install and utility scripts for AgencyStack Charter compliance
tasks.description: Systematically audit all scripts in /scripts/components/ and /scripts/utils/ for strict compliance with AgencyStack Charter v1.0.3: containerization, idempotency, no direct host modifications, all changes tracked in-repo.
tasks.details: Document any gaps or issues found. Refactor scripts as needed to ensure all operational logic is repository-driven, idempotent, and auditable.

tasks.title: Document logging and permission fixes in component docs and Charter
tasks.description: Document all recent fixes, lessons learned, and logging/permission handling strategies in /docs/pages/components/ and reference in the Charter.
tasks.details: Update documentation to reflect new patterns for privileged path handling, particularly focusing on sudo implementation for privileged paths and ensuring multi-environment compatibility. This documentation task should be completed after the practical fixes are implemented to ensure all lessons learned are captured accurately. Documentation should follow best practices including visual aids where appropriate to explain complex permission handling flows.
tasks.testStrategy: Have a peer review the documentation to verify it accurately reflects the implemented fixes and is clear enough to guide future development. Test the documentation by having a team member use it to understand and potentially replicate the permission handling patterns in a new context.

subtasks.title: Document sudo implementation patterns for privileged paths
subtasks.description: Create detailed documentation on how sudo is used for handling privileged paths, including code examples and best practices.

subtasks.title: Document multi-environment compatibility solutions
subtasks.description: Document strategies implemented for ensuring logging and permission handling works consistently across different environments.

subtasks.title: Update Charter with references to new documentation
subtasks.description: Add references in the Charter document pointing to the newly created documentation on permission handling and logging strategies.

subtasks.title: Create visual diagrams for permission flows
subtasks.description: Develop diagrams that visually represent the permission handling flows to make the documentation more accessible and easier to understand.

subtasks.title: Schedule documentation review session
subtasks.description: Organize a review session with the development team to ensure the documentation accurately reflects all implemented fixes and follows team documentation standards.

tasks.title: Update WordPress and infrastructure docs for current best practices
tasks.description: Review and update documentation for WordPress deployment and supporting infrastructure to reflect current best practices and Charter alignment.
tasks.details: Ensure all client-specific logic is multi-tenant ready and does not break AgencyStack patterns. Documentation should be actionable and clear for future deployments.

tasks.title: Verify Peace Festival USA deployment scripts for idempotency and syntax
tasks.description: Ensure all Peace Festival USA deployment scripts pass bash -n syntax check and are fully idempotent. This task is of the highest priority as it directly impacts Peace Festival USA client deployment and must be completed immediately after logging fixes.
tasks.details: Test scripts for re-runnability and correct error handling. Refactor as needed to meet Charter standards. Prioritize this verification and refactoring work directly after logging-related fixes to avoid deployment delays for the client.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Run each deployment script with 'bash -n' to check for syntax errors.
2. Execute each script multiple times in a clean and pre-existing environment to verify idempotency (no unintended side effects or failures on repeated runs).
3. Confirm proper error handling and clear exit codes in all scripts.
4. Document any changes or refactoring performed to achieve idempotency and syntax compliance.
5. Coordinate with the logging fixes team to ensure this task is started immediately after their completion.

subtasks.title: Run syntax verification on all scripts
subtasks.description: Execute bash -n on all Peace Festival USA scripts. Document and fix any syntax errors in accordance with AgencyStack Charter principles.

subtasks.title: Test idempotency of install scripts
subtasks.description: Run install scripts in clean environment, then immediately run again to verify no errors or unintended changes. Ensures full compliance with AgencyStack Charter's idempotency requirements.

subtasks.title: Validate error handling and exit codes
subtasks.description: Test Peace Festival USA scripts with various error conditions. Ensure proper exit codes and error messages following AgencyStack Charter's auditability requirements.

subtasks.title: Test script performance with patched logging
subtasks.description: Verify Peace Festival USA scripts work with new logging approach. Ensure no permission errors in VM environment while maintaining full repository integrity and idempotency.

subtasks.title: Create comprehensive deployment verification test
subtasks.description: Develop end-to-end test for full Peace Festival USA deployment. Document expected outcomes and verification points in accordance with AgencyStack Charter's test-driven development protocol.

subtasks.title: Update deployment documentation
subtasks.description: Reflect any changes made during verification in the repository documentation. Document any gotchas or special considerations to ensure future deployments benefit from current learnings.

tasks.title: Create log handling pattern library in utils directory
tasks.description: Develop a standardized log handling pattern library in scripts/utils/ that properly handles privileged paths, implements idempotent file creation, and follows Charter principles.
tasks.details: This library should provide standardized functions for log file creation, rotation, and writing that automatically detect privileged paths and use the appropriate sudo/tee patterns. All components should eventually migrate to use this pattern library instead of implementing their own log handling logic. This ensures consistent behavior across all AgencyStack components.
tasks.testStrategy: Implement unit tests that verify the library works in both privileged and unprivileged environments. Test idempotency by running functions multiple times. Verify sudo patterns work correctly by testing in environments with different permission models.

subtasks.title: Design library API and function signatures
subtasks.description: Define consistent function naming and parameter patterns for log handling. Document expected behaviors and error handling according to AgencyStack Charter principles.

subtasks.title: Implement core log creation functions
subtasks.description: Write create_log_file() with privilege awareness. Add ensure_log_directory() with proper permissions. Ensure full compliance with AgencyStack Charter's repository-as-source-of-truth principle.

subtasks.title: Implement log writing functions
subtasks.description: Create write_to_log() with privilege detection. Add timestamp and formatting standardization. Maintain strict compliance with AgencyStack Charter v1.0.3 containerization and repository integrity principles.

subtasks.title: Implement log rotation and management
subtasks.description: Add size-based and time-based rotation logic. Ensure rotated logs maintain proper permissions and follow AgencyStack directory conventions for component logs.

subtasks.title: Create migration guide for existing scripts
subtasks.description: Document how to convert existing log handling to new library. Provide examples for common patterns. Ensure alignment with AgencyStack Charter's repository integrity and documentation requirements.

subtasks.title: Add comprehensive testing
subtasks.description: Create test suite for all functions in privileged/unprivileged contexts. Verify idempotency and error handling. Follows AgencyStack test-driven development protocol.

tasks.title: Implement permission-aware directory creation utility
tasks.description: Create a robust utility function that properly creates directories with correct ownership and permissions, using sudo when appropriate for privileged paths.
tasks.details: The utility should detect when paths require elevated privileges (e.g., /var/log/agency_stack) and use sudo appropriately. It should be idempotent, handle errors gracefully, and work consistently across different environments (VM, container, dev environment). This utility will be used by all component scripts to ensure consistent directory creation patterns that follow Charter principles.
tasks.testStrategy: Test in both privileged and unprivileged contexts, verify idempotency through repeated executions, and ensure proper error handling when permissions are insufficient.
